reviews.text: 🧸💕🤍🐶🐾 Just look at my happy Pomeranian puppy with her fresh haircut after visiting Valeria’s grooming place. After one really bad experience with haircuts in Barcelona we are so happy to find this place. 10/10! …

I have an 11-year-old Shiba Inu. I've never taken her to a groomer because she's very timid and nervous, and any place that smells like a vet terrifies her, so you can imagine how much hair I've had to remove. I finally decided to go, and I couldn't be happier. They made me feel very calm, and my dog ​​did too, although it must have taken them a while. Valeria and Alexia, thank you for your work. I've found my go-to dog groomer!
The service and treatment were excellent!!

A perfect 10 experience. From the very first moment, it's clear that they don't just work with animals here, but that they understand them and treat them with immense care, patience, and respect. Their professionalism is impeccable: they know exactly what they're doing, offer expert advice, and explain everything very clearly, from the most suitable cut to helpful tips for coat and skin care, and the overall well-being of your dog.
The service is friendly, kind, and meticulous, both with the animals and their owners. It's incredibly reassuring to leave your dog in the hands of someone who inspires so much confidence and whose experience, knowledge, and genuine passion for their work are evident.

The result was spectacular: a clean, beautiful, and well-executed finish, with meticulous attention to every detail. You can see the difference when someone does things with passion and dedication. My dog ​​left looking gorgeous, calm, and happy, which is ultimately the most important thing.
Without a doubt, this dog groomer is highly recommended for anyone looking for a professional, caring, and high-quality service. We will definitely be back.
I recommend groomer Valeria.
I trust my pets only to Valeria and Olechka! We always look beautiful in their magical hands! Greetings from Benya the Yorkie and Fima the cat!
We took our dog for a stripping treatment and were very happy with the results. We had previously taken him to other dog groomers in the neighborhood, and this one is by far the best.

This is simply the best salon in all of Barcelona! We have been to many places and here we found true professionals and the right approach! Very grateful for the work with our not very obedient dog😅 very correct work with spitz and their hair👍🏻🐶❤️😘😘😘 …
They did a good job (washed and dried) but I found it unethical that they charged me considerably more than what was indicated on the website, because it seems that poodles are charged more.
Great place and attentive staff!
Freddy met Valeria for the first time and left looking very handsome and satisfied with the service and styling. Thank you, we'll be back!

I absolutely loved everything about this grooming salon. The place is clean, and you can see them working and treating the animals from the street, which gives you a lot of confidence. It was my first time taking my dog ​​there, and they made her look gorgeous. I used to take her to other places, and she always asked for a short cut and came out looking like an old lady's dog. But here, they cut her hair, and she looks like a puppy! She came out super clean and polished. I'll definitely always take her here. The groomer seems so sweet and attentive to the animals; you can tell she loves her job. Minnie says thank you!! ♥️♥️
Perfect!
The best dog groomer ever! I'm thrilled with how she treats my fur babies 🥰🥰🥰 100/10. Highly recommended. …
Excellent service and personalized attention! Our four-legged friends enjoy their treatments with Valeria.
Very good service!
Excellent service, they combed and washed the cat, brushed her teeth ☺️ I am very satisfied
After a teeth cleaning, I took my dog ​​to the emergency room. She coughed all day from swallowing water and whined in pain until the doctor cleaned her mouth. I highly recommend it.
After unsuccessful attempts with local groomers, we only go to Valeria, even though it's not close. No one listens to us or does a better job than her. And most importantly, she loves animals!
Thank you so much for your great professionalism, we are very happy.

Excellent work, very good value for money. Very good experience, highly recommended.
Carme & Jordi

Very professional and friendly service. In such short notice they were able to meet our needs. My Yorkshire Terrier was pampered, had a wash, haircut, nails and a massage. I was very impressed with the level of service, especially because my dog had just spent 2 months in quarantine in Great Britain and has been very scared since. The staff were made aware and gave special care to my dog, making sure he was as calm as possible. Great service, we will be back. Thanks!
